Padding and receivers without earlier donors receive zero history updates. Statistics, gates and history output accumulate in float32. Earlier token inputs can now influence a receiver's query/value update through the adapter itself. Width, head, activation or initialization changes cannot create this causal dependency.

proposal.why_not_parameter_only: Introduces an ordered pairwise visual representation and a new edge-to-reserved information path. Root projects final tokens independently; n0011/n0012 read absolute image content through latent slots, and covariance families discard token order. This candidate retrieves signed differences between adjacent merged image embeddings using midpoint keys, without slots or moment operators. Constant image sequences yield zero reads even with nonzero output weights; a completed CPU example showed that reversing a single image edge negates its read. n0006 transports neighboring action-step differences between action receivers, whereas this branch builds visual-prefix edge donors and lets reserved queries retrieve them. Widths, heads, activations or initialization changes alone cannot introduce these donors and dependencies.
